<|assistant|>
post-intervention-response:
Um, I guess... I really like having a diverse social network because it helps me learn so much about different perspectives and cultures. It's like, you know, getting to hear stories from all over the world and understanding how people live differently. It's fascinating.

As for maintaining those connections, I try to be really open and listen a lot. I make sure to ask questions and show genuine interest in what others have to say. I also try to reach out regularly, maybe send a message or give them a call just to catch up. It's not always easy, but it's important to me.

I know it might sound weird, but I find comfort in knowing that there are people out there who care about me, even if we don't see each other often. It's like, having a safety net of friends who understand and support me, no matter what. That's what I cherish the most.

As for maintaining those connections, well, I try to be there for people when they need someone to talk to. I send messages or give them a call just to check in, you know? And I make an effort to remember important dates and events for them, like birthdays or anniversaries. It's not always easy, but it's important to me to show that I care.

I also try to be open and listen to what others have to say. It's like, when you're open, people feel more comfortable sharing their thoughts and feelings with you. And that's really special, I think. It's like, we all have our own stories, and it's nice to be a part of each other's lives.
